notes: Decorative shape or container background. Built-in geometric shapes via CSS/SVG. API shapes from D1. Can wrap child atoms (Icon, text). textonly: null for decorative. Container behaviour auto-detected from slot/media. Shapes can be ui-control / content-symbol for interactive scrollytelling — they get tabindex, role=img, aria-label, focus indicators just like Icon.

_rules.action: Shape strips the matching colour props from the child's spread so the child falls back to inheriting currentColor — which Shape.css computes as an oklch lightness inversion of --_color, producing a visible contrast against the filled background.

_rules.note: ui-control and content-symbol shapes must have labelShape for screen readers

Shape with semanticRole='background' is wallpaper for a child atom. The child owns aria/label; Shape stays aria-hidden. Use this when Shape appears as media inside Heading/List/Badge to make the intent explicit.
drawColor only accepts base colour variants or rainbow — no tier modifiers (tint/mid/emphasis). Atom strips them at runtime via normalizeDrawColour.
When draw and fillAnimation are both used, fillTiming controls whether fill bloom overlaps draw at 50% (default) or starts after draw completes ('after')

Radial gradients only read as radial at 2xl and above. Below that the gradient compresses into apparent flat colour. Runtime auto-downgrades to linear with a dev warn so AI-generated JSON can't render broken radial shapes. For radial on small surfaces, use Card or Section.

mode._note: shape: renders as visible shape. mask: uses shape as clip-path on content.

renderAs._note: auto: CSS for circle/square/rounded/pill, SVG for everything else. css: force CSS path (only valid for css-capable shapes). svg: force SVG path.

slug._note: API shape slug — fetches SVG from Asset Library

semanticRole._note: decorative: aria-hidden, no label. background: aria-hidden wallpaper for a child atom — child owns meaning, labelShape forbidden, media required. ui-control: tabindex 0 + role=img + labelShape. content-symbol: role=img + labelShape. Container behaviour (rendered shape__content wrapper) is auto-detected from slot/media.

labelShape._note: Required for ui-control and content-symbol. Forbidden for background. Atom-suffixed name (label<Atom>) avoids collisions when Shape is composed inside other atoms.

colorTier._note: Implicit baseline is 'base' (set by .color--{name} mixin; no .color--tier-* class emitted). Omit to use.

media._description: Nested atom node. Shape becomes a container for the child atom — the child owns its own props (colour, weight, animation). When Shape itself is purely wallpaper (composed inside Heading/List/Badge as mediaBg), set Shape's semanticRole='background' so meaning lives only on the child.

gradientType._note: Implicit baseline is 'linear' (no radial suffix added to gradient name; data-grad-focus attribute omitted). Omit to use.

gradientFocus._note: Radial origin point — only used when gradientType=radial. Implicit baseline is 'center' (resolved via `gradientFocus || 'center'` fallback at runtime). Omit to use.

gradientEmerge._description: Fade-in modifier — first 50% transparent, fades to solid. Combines with any gradient or solid colour.

gradientFade._description: Fade-out modifier — last 20% fades to transparent. Combines with any gradient or solid colour.

gradientAnimateSpeed._note: Animation speed — slow (20s), default (12s), fast (6s). Matches Icon/Heading/Badge. Gated by motion settings. Implicit baseline is 'default' (no .gradient--speed-* class emitted). Omit to use.

gradientAnimateDirection._note: Implicit baseline is 'cw' (no [data-grad-anim-dir] / [data-icon-grad-dir] attribute emitted). Omit to use.

gradientCycle._description: Colour cycle — cross-fades through the element's own tier tokens (tint→mid→base→emphasis). Matches Heading/Badge.

mediaBgSize._note: Padding around child atom when Shape wraps media (auto-detected). Matches Heading.mediaBgSize / List.mediaBgSize. Em-based so it scales with child's text context.

animationRepeat.description: How many times to play: once, loop (infinite), three (3x then stop), threeloop (3x then pause [interval] then repeat). Default = threeloop, matches Icon/LottieIcon.

animationInterval.description: Gap between attention-pulse bursts. Token-driven (motion-mode scaled). Used by animationRepeat=threeloop and animationTrigger=interval. Matches Icon/LottieIcon.

drawGhost._note: Use --svg-ghost-color token for ghost stroke (no separate ghostColor prop needed)

drawColor._note: BASE colours only — no tier modifiers. Tier suffixes are stripped at runtime. Rainbow colours use positional names (rainbow-1..7) matching CSS tokens.

drawWormSize._note: Laser worm segment length token. Resolved to path percentage at runtime (xs=5%, sm=10%, md=20%, lg=35%, xl=60%). Matches Icon.

drawOnScroll._note: Trigger draw when element enters viewport

drawScrub._note: Scrub draw progress with scroll position (only with drawOnScroll)

morphTo._note: Built-in shape name OR D1 slug. Goo morph technique applies automatically.

fillAnimation._note: Bloom fill from centre on trigger

fillOutline._note: Also draw stroke outline using addVariant — combines with fillDrawVariant/fillDrawLaser

fillMode._note: Implicit baseline is 'once' (no [data-icon-fill-mode] attribute emitted). Omit to use.

fillDuration._note: Bloom duration token. Resolved to seconds at runtime (fast=0.5s, normal=1s, slow=1.6s, slower=2.4s). Matches Icon.

fillTiming._note: When draw + fill combined: overlap starts fill at 50% draw, after waits for draw to finish
